question: Where was the 2025 G7 Outreach Summit held?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kananaskis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Prime Minister addresses the G7 Outreach Session.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**PM Narendra Modi** attended the **G7 Outreach Summit** in **Kananaskis, Canada**.

 
 
• 
 
This marks his **6th consecutive participation** in the G7 Summit.

 
 
• 
 
The **2025 summit theme** focused on:

 
 
• 
 
**Protecting communities worldwide**

 
 
• 
 
**Building energy security & digital transition**

 
 
• 
 
**Securing future partnerships**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The **G7** (Group of Seven) is an **informal grouping** of **7 major economies** and the **European Union** (as observer).

 
 
• 
 
**Founded in 1975** in response to the **oil crisis**, initially as **G6** (France, Germany, Italy, Japan, UK, USA).

 
 
• 
 
**Canada joined in 1976**, forming the **G7**.

 
 
• 
 
**Russia joined in 1998**, creating the **G8**, but was **excluded in 2014**, returning to G7 format.

 
 
• 
 
In **2025**, the G7 marks **50 years of cooperation**.
